Published on 28 February 2023

Image: Indexes.jpg

Mildura Rural City Council Libraries have available indexes of births, deaths, and marriages notices from local newspapers.

  * The Mildura Cultivator 1888 - 1920
  * Sunraysia Daily October 1920 - 1999

 

These indexes can be viewed at the Mildura Library.

Please ask our friendly staff if you have any queries.
